name: Core Sentinel
description:
Honest system load and hardware health in the top bar.

• CPU load over physical cores: SMT sibling threads merged, so 12 busy cores on a 24-thread CPU read 100%, not 50%.
• Pressure (PSI) for CPU, memory and I/O: whether a resource is actually slowing work down.
• Memory without page cache, zram and swap on disk shown apart; filesystems and disk I/O; AMD GPU load and VRAM.
• Every hwmon sensor: temperatures, fans with PWM duty, voltages, power.
• Alerts: stalled or stopped fans, hot sensors, nearly full disks, memory spilling to disk, thrashing.
• Fans never seen spinning are treated as not connected; rename, hide and set limits per sensor.

Reads only /proc and /sys. No network, no helper processes.
